title: Suspicious LOLBin descendant of svchost.exe
description: vol_pslist surfaced powershell.exe (PID 4321) with PPID 1244 (svchost.exe). svchost typically spawns service workers, not interactive shells; this combination is associated with scheduled-task lateral execution patterns documented in MITRE ATT&CK T1053.005.
hypothesis: scheduled-task abuse pre-promotes the powershell child via the service host

title: Periodic outbound TLS to non-corporate IP from APSDaemon.exe
description: vol_netscan shows APSDaemon.exe (PID 13224) with an ESTABLISHED TCPv4 connection to 17.57.144.165:5223. The remote address is outside RFC1918 / typical Apple Push (17.0.0.0/8) ranges and the destination port pattern matches XMPP-over-TLS beaconing periodicity worth correlating against process create_time.

title: PID 9999 in netscan but absent from pslist active list
description: vol_netscan reports PID 9999 (owner svchost.exe) bound to TCPv4 LISTENING on 0.0.0.0:65500. vol_pslist's active EPROCESS walk does not contain PID 9999. The combination — port-bound endpoint with no entry in the active list — is a known DKOM-hiding signal documented in MITRE ATT&CK T1014.

evidence_refs.detail: PID 9999 absent from pslist active list

hypothesis: DKOM hiding leaves the pool tag (netscan visible) while unlinking the EPROCESS (pslist invisible)
